title: Human-like intelligent automatic treatment planning of head and neck cancer radiation therapy
summary: A hierarchical neural planner generates head-and-neck cancer radiotherapy plans and reports dose-volume performance against clinical planning targets and comparison plans. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
organization: University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center

evidence.tested: A hierarchical neural planner generates head-and-neck cancer radiotherapy plans and reports dose-volume performance against clinical planning targets and comparison plans.
evidence.unknown: No prospective clinical benefit or broader external validity is established by the documented study.
evidence.ai_role: The source evaluates the VTP planner on the AAMD 2023 plan-study case and compares target/OAR dosimetry and plan quality.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
